headline: Composite Index Rebounds Today; Market Starts Placing Bets Ahead of Economic Data
summary: The IHSG closed up 27.39 points, or 0.46%, at 6,036.89 on Friday afternoon. Market players are positioning ahead of several key domestic economic data releases next week.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is Indonesia's main stock benchmark, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect local investor sentiment and expectations for domestic economic data.
